final_decision_status: PASS — CHAMPION VERIFIED, READY FOR SPRINT 4

primary_edge_champion.target_environment: Edge / Resource-Constrained (RTX 3050 Laptop, Embedded Linux, Low-Storage Containers)
primary_edge_champion.justification: Stetho-MSAE slashes parameter count by 74% (559,873 params vs. 2,154,624 params) and serialized disk footprint to 4.31 MB (vs. 16.58 MB), with 38% faster cold loading (46.87 ms vs. 75.89 ms). It achieves perfect 1.0000 ROC-AUC on id_00 and id_02, and 0.9778 on id_06, with macro ROC-AUC of 0.9445.

secondary_accuracy_baseline.justification: Dense Autoencoder achieves higher macro ROC-AUC (0.9722 vs. 0.9445) and higher pAUC (0.9561 vs. 0.9386), with superior performance on id_04 (0.9111 vs. 0.8000) and 2.6x faster CPU inference (43.70 ms vs. 116.05 ms). It is retained as an active high-fidelity option where 16.6 MB model size is acceptable.

corrected_claims: CORRECTED: Stetho-MSAE does NOT outperform Dense Autoencoder on id_04 (DAE 0.9111 ROC-AUC vs. MSAE 0.8000 ROC-AUC).
CORRECTED: Dense Autoencoder macro ROC-AUC (0.9722) is higher than Stetho-MSAE macro ROC-AUC (0.9445).
CORRECTED: Dense Autoencoder has faster CPU inference latency (43.70 ms vs. 116.05 ms) due to BLAS-optimized dense matrix multiplies vs. un-fused 2D depthwise convolution loops on CPU.
VERIFIED: Stetho-MSAE holds massive efficiency superiority (74% parameter reduction, 74% storage reduction, faster cold loading) and superior ranking on id_00 (1.0000 vs. 0.9778).
critical_audit_findings.calibration_limitations: Both models suffer from severe operating threshold variance when calibrated on only N=2 normal dev clips. Low recall on id_00 (0.1333) and high FPR on id_04/id_06 (0.67 - 1.00) are calibration quantile estimation artifacts, not ranking discrimination failures. A three-zone classification engine ([theta_lower, theta_upper]) with provisional uncertainty flags is mandatory for all user-facing inspection outputs.
critical_audit_findings.robustness_distinctions: Robustness testing confirmed that simple audio gain changes (+6 dB / -6 dB) alter log-Mel energy and trigger false anomalies unless audio preprocessing enforces peak/RMS normalization. An acoustic quality gating module (RMS, clipping, silence check) must precede anomaly inference to differentiate sensor/recording faults from mechanical degradation.
